handoff: Approve. Round-1 F1-F4 verified fixed; AC1-AC5 pass at S1 (machine-dir.test.ts 6/6), AC6 by hand per handoff; D2/D9/D10 match. Full suite green (test:fast 949/949, test:cli 488/488), typecheck green. No blocking findings. Minor: checkout.json only written by heartbeatId; doctor scratchUnit ignores a failed git init; process-wide homes map; D9 headless test recomputes its expected path. Nits: adopt command also rm -rf's the own dir (say so in PR), silent fallback on bad checkout.json, test homes never removed.

findings.title: checkout.json is written only by heartbeatId
findings.detail:
D3: 'Each machine dir holds a small checkout.json'. A machine dir created by brief/hook/status before the first tick has none, so doctor can never call it an orphan. AC1 is met (it says after a tick).
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Write it wherever the machine dir is first created, or in Context.locate.

findings.title: Adopting command also deletes the current machine dir
findings.detail:
AC5 asks for 'the mv that adopts it'; the printed command runs rm -rf on the own dir first, discarding the trace written since the move. Needed because the own dir always exists; worth a line in the PR description.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Mention in the PR body.

findings.title: D9 test recomputes its expected value
findings.detail:
runnerLogDir(root) is checked against join(machineDir(root), 'runs'), the same functions under test. D9 rests on AC6's hand check; machine-dir.test.ts imports the store internal unbindNornHome to reset state.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Assert a literal path under a known home.

findings.title: git init failure in scratchUnit is ignored
findings.detail:
run() returns {code} rather than throwing, so the catch never fires. If git init fails and $TMPDIR sits inside a checkout, checkoutOf walks up to that checkout, bindNornHome rebinds it, and drop() rm -rf's that checkout's machine dir.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Check the exit code and throw.

findings.title: Process-wide home binding (Shotgun Surgery)
findings.detail:
homes is a module-level map keyed by common dir, last bind wins; five entry points (context.ts, hook.ts, doctor.ts, view load.ts, trace-view.ts) must remember to bind, and read-model functions mutate it as a side effect. Two Contexts with different homes for one repo in one process switch each other's machine dir.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Pass the home with the root (a located checkout value) in a later refactor.

findings.title: Corrupt checkout.json falls back silently
findings.detail:
readLocalJson is called without root, so a bad file emits no local_file trace event.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Pass root.

findings.title: Test homes never removed
findings.detail:
Every test process mkdtemps a norn-test-home-* dir that nothing deletes.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Remove it on process exit.

findings.title: Moved-and-renamed repo is not reported
findings.detail:
Orphan match needs the same folder name, per AC5/D3; a move with a rename leaves an unreported dir.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: None needed for this slice.
